<jats:p>We present a systematic methodology for developing and validating quantum algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs).
This methodology includes partition function-based transformations to map LLM embedding similarity values to a range suitable for quantum computation, and the design of a shallow-circuit quantum algorithm for estimating this transformed similarity
measure on nearterm quantum computers. We rigorously evaluate our approach through quantum simulations and experiments
on real quantum hardware, demonstrating the feasibility of using quantum computing for LLM embedding analysis. Our results
highlight the potential for quantum-inspired techniques in LLM tasks and demonstrate practical strategies for achieving reliable
results on noisy quantum hardware.</jats:p>
